name: strawverse-root
description: StrawVerse - Download anime & manga in batches, unified across Desktop & Android

scripts.start:desktop: npm run build:gui && cd electron && npm start
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:gui && cd electron && npm run package
scripts.build:desktop:mac: npm run build:gui && cd electron && npm run package:mac
scripts.build:desktop:all: npm run build:gui && cd electron && npm run package:all
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:gui && cd capacitor && npm run sync:android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && cd capacitor/android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.test: node --test backend/utils/constants.test.js backend/utils/mediaSource.test.js backend/utils/extensionMetadata.test.js backend/utils/mangaAssets.test.js backend/utils/downloaderRange.test.js backend/utils/queueRetry.test.js gui/src/utils/catalogMerge.test.js gui/src/utils/mediaBadges.test.js gui/src/utils/imageUrl.test.js gui/src/utils/downloadProgress.test.js
